components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A restrained petrol action for the page's strongest command.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #17343b); border-radius: 6px; color: #fff; background: var(--ink, #17343b); font: 750 11px/1.2 Manrope, sans-serif; transition: background .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-soft, #24515a); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--ocean-teal, #206a78); }

components.name: Utility Button
components.description: Compact evidence controls with a 44px mobile target.
components.css: .ds-button-utility { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b7c9c4); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--body, #45565b); background: #fff; font: 750 11px/1.2 Manrope, sans-serif; transition: border-color .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button-utility:hover { border-color: #6c969c; color: #1f6573; background: #edf5f4; } .ds-button-utility:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--ocean-teal, #206a78); } @media (max-width: 899px) { .ds-button-utility { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Evidence Card
components.description: A ruled paper module for charts and analytical evidence.
components.html:
Pipeline contribution

Direct units, interpretation, caveat, and data alternative stay together.
components.css: .ds-evidence-card { padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b7c9c4); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink, #17343b); background: #fff; transition: border-color .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-evidence-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 650 17px/1.16 Newsreader, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.012em; } .ds-evidence-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--body, #45565b); font: 400 12px/1.55 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-card:hover { border-color: #6d9295; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(23,52,59,.08); }

components.name: Confidence Chip
components.description: A textual confidence marker whose meaning survives without color.
components.css: .ds-confidence-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 23px; align-items: center; padding: 0 7px; border: 1px solid #d9b69f; border-radius: 5px; color: #7d4b35; background: #faeee7; font: 850 9px/1 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A petrol-rail destination with the signature copper trace.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 36px; align-items: center; padding: 0 10px 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; color: #bad0d0; background: #17343b; font: 520 12px/1.2 Manrope, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { border-color: #3a6469; color: #fff; background: #1d4147; } .ds-nav-item-active { border-color: #4d7e82; color: #fff; background: #214d55; } .ds-nav-item-active::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 8px auto 8px 0; width: 2px; background: #e2aa67; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--ocean-teal, #206a78); }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: A compact, tabular evidence surface with mineral row states.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: #45565b; background: #fff; font: 400 12px/1.4 Manrope, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 9px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e0dd; text-align: left; } .ds-table th { color: #24515a; background: #e6eeeb; font-size: 10px; } .ds-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #f4f8f6; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #e9f2f1; }

narrative.overview: The interface feels like an operator's evidence desk: deep petrol framing, mineral paper, ruled modules, ocean-teal signals, and warm copper or terracotta only where interpretation demands attention. It is dense but not cramped, editorial but not theatrical, and designed to make analytical confidence visible. The page is a presentation layer over a validated schema-v2 data contract. Preserve the source metrics, caveats, required section order, chart/table parity, export paths, presentation and print modes, and the /full-analysis archive. Visual changes must not silently recalculate, omit, or reframe the evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Decision first; evidence, implication, and action remain traceable.
Petrol command rail, mineral canvas, paper modules, and fine rules.
Newsreader gives conclusions authority; Manrope keeps controls and data legible.
Color carries semantic meaning and is reinforced by labels, patterns, or copy.

rules.name: The Accountable Color Rule
rules.body: A semantic color keeps the same meaning across KPIs, charts, caveats, and actions; labels and patterns preserve that meaning without color.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Newsreader speaks for interpretation; Manrope speaks for operation and evidence. Do not introduce a third display or UI family.

rules.name: The Content-Preservation Rule
rules.body: Responsive and presentation modes may reflow or focus the evidence, but must retain required sections, labels, denominators, accessible summaries, table/download alternatives, and the original analytical order.

rules.name: The Ruled-First Rule
rules.body: Prefer a one-pixel mineral border or tonal step before adding elevation.

dos: **Do** lead with the operating decision, then show evidence, limitations, and the measurable action.
**Do** keep chart summaries, caveats, data tables, downloads, print output, and schema validation intact.
**Do** use rules and mineral tonal layers as the primary composition system.
**Do** retain 44px mobile controls and visible keyboard focus.
donts: **Don't** replace the signal atlas with a generic blue KPI wall, glassmorphism, gradients, or decorative 3D.
**Don't** use warm colors ornamentally or let color become the only carrier of meaning.
**Don't** hide analytical sections, change denominators, or overstate observational evidence as causal.
**Don't** preload the chart module or let chart code block the decision-first shell.
